change_summary_ar: نفّذت القدرة الأولى لرفع أربع ملفات منفصلة مع بعض (حضور + موظف + وردية + إجازة): باراميتر اختياري جديد auxiliary_paths على engine.process_file، ودوال جديدة في calculation_engine.py (read_single_workbook_source, read_auxiliary_sources, enrich_with_auxiliary_sources, process_auxiliary_sources) تقرأ كل مصدر إثرائي من ملفه المستقل. رُبط الموظف فقط بالحضور (مفتاح بسيط employee_id 1:1)؛ الوردية والإجازة تُقرأان وتُتحققان بشكل مستقل ويظهر عددهما في النتيجة، لكن ربطهما الزمني بتاريخ العمل مؤجل لمرحلة تالية موثقة ولم يُدّعَ حدوثه.
core_change_reason: See PROJECT.json core_change.reason: additive-only change, existing process_file(path, source_name) call signature and behavior are unaffected.
environment: Linux build workspace; Windows runtime not tested

acceptance_cases_covered.all_four_sources_delivered_together: PASS: attendance + employee + roster + leave uploaded in one call; employee fields joined onto matching attendance rows.
acceptance_cases_covered.missing_source_visible_not_silent: PASS: a follow-up upload without roster/leave still succeeds; auxiliary_sources.roster.delivered and .leave.delivered are false and a warning names each missing source.
acceptance_cases_covered.unknown_employee_visible_not_silent: PASS: an attendance row referencing an employee_id absent from the employee source is still accepted (not rejected); employee_employment_status stays blank for that row and unknown_employee_references counts it with a warning.
acceptance_cases_covered.late_correction_isolated: PASS: correcting one attendance_id's worked/late minutes changes only that record; three other, unrelated records (including one from a later work_date) are unchanged.
acceptance_cases_covered.history_never_wiped: PASS: after three sequential uploads, engine.runs() lists all three source files; nothing was overwritten.

limitations: Roster and leave are read and validated but not yet linked to attendance by employee + work date; that is PROGRAM_MAP.md step 2, not started.
The synthetic dataset keeps leave in the same workbook as attendance; whether real production data truly splits them into separate files is still unconfirmed.
No HTTP/dashboard.html upload flow for multiple files was built in this stage; only the engine.process_file(..., auxiliary_paths=...) function was implemented and tested directly.
Not tested on Windows or with a password-protected workbook for any of the four sources.
